kultivator.tema.cmd.help.title: Themed Town Tests
kultivator.tema.cmd.help.none: No themed town test commands are registered yet.
kultivator.kota_tema.pelabuhan.sumber: Source: Quanzhou (known to foreign merchants as 'Zayton'), one of the world's busiest ports in the Song-Yuan era (10th-14th century) and a node of the Maritime Silk Road; UNESCO World Heritage 2021 'Quanzhou: Emporium of the World in Song-Yuan China'. Quanzhou's Tianhou Temple is dedicated to the sea goddess Mazu; the Wanshou Pagoda was a famous navigation mark of the time; at the Zhenwu Temple officials made offerings to the sea. Town plan, characters, prices and numbers are game design.
kultivator.kota_tema.oasis.sumber: Source: Dunhuang on the Silk Road; the Crescent Moon Spring (Yueyaquan), a crescent-shaped pool among the Mingsha dunes, which are known to 'sing' when the wind blows and which, it is said, never buried it in sand; the Jade Gate (Yumenguan) and Yangguan, the last posts for travellers heading west. Inspired by the Mogao cave murals and the camel caravans of the Silk Road; town plan, characters, prices and numbers are game design.
kultivator.kota_tema.air.sumber: Source: Zhouzhuang in Kunshan near Suzhou, a water town with the Ming-era Twin Bridges: the round-arched Shide Bridge and the square-arched Yong'an Bridge meeting at the corner of two canals; the Grand Canal and the classical gardens of Suzhou; Suzhou silk and Biluochun green tea from the Dongting hills on Lake Tai. Water lanterns: the custom of floating lotus lanterns on rivers on the night of the Zhongyuan Festival in Jiangsu and Fujian to light the way of the spirits. Festival schedule, characters, prices and numbers are game design.
kultivator.kota_tema.gunung.sumber: Source: Mount Emei, one of the sacred mountains of Chinese Buddhism, with the Golden Summit (Jinding) at about 3,077 m, its golden hall and gilded statue of Samantabhadra (Puxian); Baoguo Temple at the foot is the start of the pilgrimage; sunrise, the sea of clouds and the 'Buddha's light' are known as the wonders of its summit. The cliff plank road is inspired by the plank walk on Huashan's South Peak; the terraced town with stilt houses on the cliff edge is inspired by the mountain city of Chongqing. Town plan, characters, prices and numbers are game design.
kultivator.kota_tema.iblis.sumber: Inspired by the Black-Corner Region in Battle Through the Heavens by Tian Can Tu Dou, a leaderless land where factions kill one another for profit, with the Black Mark City that charges a steep entry fee (Wuxiaworld translation, around chapters 383-387); and by the common xianxia tropes of the demonic-path city, the blood arena and bounty hunts by righteous sects. Town plan, characters, prices and numbers are game design.
kultivator.kota_tema.tiba.pelabuhan: Salt wind, matting sails and the shouts of porters greet you: %s.
kultivator.kota_tema.tiba.oasis: Beyond the mud-brick walls a crescent of water glitters in the sand: %s.
kultivator.kota_tema.tiba.air: White walls, black tiles and boats gliding under stone bridges: %s.
kultivator.kota_tema.tiba.gunung: A thousand stone steps begin here, climbing through pine mist to a golden summit: %s.
kultivator.kota_tema.tiba.iblis: The air smells of iron and black incense. You enter %s. Here, only the market is not a battlefield.
kultivator.kota_tema.tiba.baru: A new themed town is noted on your map and in the Trade Ledger (/kultivasi dagang). Hover the town name for its Source.
kultivator.kota_tema.temu.reruntuhan_gur: A toppled tower and a half-buried gate: you have found a Desert Ruin, a town swallowed by the sand.
kultivator.kota_tema.temu.pos_pemburu: A righteous sect's banner flies over a command tent: a Hunters' Camp, where the demon-bounty hunters rest.
kultivator.kota_tema.infami.naik: Your Infamy rises to %s. The righteous sects begin to remember your face.
kultivator.kota_tema.iblis.tolak_tagihan: You refuse to pay the Blood Price. This city's enforcers will hunt you until tomorrow, and their fear of you wanes.

kultivator.kota_tema.dagang.jenuh_pering: The market is getting flooded with this good.

kultivator.kota_tema.dagang.peti_kosong: This crate is still empty. Seal goods into it at a market.
kultivator.kota_tema.dagang.peti_luar_ko: A Trade Crate may only be opened inside a town, before market witnesses.

kultivator.kota_tema.dagang.bea_maaf: The customs officer notes your cargo and waves you through. This time you are let off.
kultivator.kota_tema.dagang.bea_bebas: Your Desert Pass is checked. No duty.

kultivator.sibuk.tema.pelayaran: Busy: you are sailing across to the Boundless Sea.
kultivator.sibuk.tema.perahu: Busy: you are riding a canal boat.
kultivator.sibuk.tema.lift: Busy: you are in a cable car or a pulley basket.
kultivator.sibuk.tema.arena: Busy: you are fighting in the Blood Arena.
kultivator.sibuk.tema.tari: Busy: you are dancing, weaving or beating the drum.
kultivator.misi.muatan.cerita: A merchant entrusts crates sealed with red lacquer that must reach the destination town before time runs out. A cracked seal voids the contract, so let no one, yourself included, peek inside.
kultivator.misi.kawal_unta.cerita: The caravan master seeks guards for a camel string crossing the dunes. Desert bandits lurk behind the ridges, and a sandstorm can come with little warning.
kultivator.misi.reruntuhan.cerita: The oasis scholars pay well for an object from the buried hall of a desert ruin. Its sand doors open only for the patient, and a giant scorpion is said to guard the deepest room.
kultivator.misi.antar_sutra.judul: A Parcel from the Silk House
kultivator.misi.antar_sutra.cerita: House Su needs a parcel of silk delivered by hand, not by the post boat. Their old customer dislikes cloth wet with canal spray.
kultivator.misi.herba_tebing.cerita: The Herb Hall orders one stem of a herb that grows only on the cliff face. Use a climbing rope, and do not stare down for too long.
kultivator.misi.pencuri_kanal.cerita: A boat thief nicknamed the Water Rat snatches goods from canal-side stalls and vanishes under the bridges. Hire a boat, chase him and bring the stolen goods back.
kultivator.misi.bajak_laut.cerita: A black-sailed ship is sighted on the horizon. The harbour master calls every blade he can pay to hold the piers before the pirates loot the warehouses.
kultivator.misi.buronan_iblis.cerita: The Bounty Board at the Hunters' Camp shows the face of a demonic-path cultivator seen on the roads. The righteous sect pays whoever brings them down, alive or helpless.
kultivator.misi.tebus_tawanan.cerita: A mother in a village waits for her child taken to the Captive Pens of the Demon City. Ransom them and bring them home; in that city nothing may be bought but freedom.

advancement.kultivator.tempat.tema_lente: Float a lotus lantern on the Night of Water Lanterns.
advancement.kultivator.tempat.tema_tebus: Ransom a captive from the Captive Pens.
advancement.kultivator.tempat.tema_penen: Finish the cloth left beneath the water.
advancement.kultivator.tempat.tema_pezia: Receive the Summit Blessing at the Golden Hall.
advancement.kultivator.tempat.tema_juara: Win all nine bouts of the Blood Ladder.
advancement.kultivator.tempat.tema_pemut: Finish the Demon City chain by freeing the captives.
advancement.kultivator.tempat.tema_pemba: Bring the first morning to the Demon City.
advancement.kultivator.tempat.tema_tamu_: Sit as a guest at the Blood Feast without spilling blood.
